stage: Brand new under 100 followers across all platforms; building trust with minimal engagement
summary: Instagram bio violates brand rules: names specific niches (hotels, cafes, gyms, homestays) and region (Himachal), states a 24-hour delivery timeframe, and offers a free site check outside website posts. Reels lose 77% viewers in first 3 seconds. Lead_gen outperforms chatbot 5:1 per reach. Contrast/comparison hooks and mistake angles work best but n<5. Bluesky last 4 posts zero engagement.
guidance:
- Rotate to **contrast** or **comparison** hooks; pause **question** hooks (0.48x angle, 21% of comparison per reach).
- Lead with the **budget-for-video** pain point (top problem) using a **mistake** angle (1.88x).
- Use **desk-glow** or **bright-desk** image style (1.91x, 1.46x).
- Avoid reel format until 3-second hook is fixed; if video, front-load the problem visually.
- Every post must read like a developer sharing real work, never an ad. Offer only: pay after approval or a short DM conversation.

instructions.research: List 3 common budget/video-production pains Indian small businesses mention in comments/forums (e.g., 'can't afford camera crew', 'stock footage looks generic', 'editing takes too long').
instructions.analysis: Compare the 3 animated_ads posts (10-30, 11-03, 11-06) — all used question hooks. Note reach/engagement vs lead_gen posts using comparison/contrast hooks.
instructions.writer: Write a contrast hook: 'Professional video ads cost ₹50k–₹2L. AI animation delivers 80% of the polish for a fraction. The mistake? Thinking you need a camera crew.' Keep it one screen, end with 'DM me — I’ll tell you if it fits your business.'
instructions.image: Create a desk-glow style static carousel: slide 1 shows a laptop with a rough storyboard sketch; slide 2 shows the same frame rendered as clean AI animation. No logos, no client names. Caption: 'From sketch to motion — no shoot required.'
instructions.video: Skip reel today. If you must post video, make a 5-second loop: split screen — left side 'Quoting a video agency', right side 'Generating AI ad in browser'. No talking head. First frame must show the cost gap visually.

manual_tips: Rewrite Instagram bio to: 'Websites, AI chatbots, AI animated ads & lead lists for small businesses across India. Pay after approval. DM for honest advice.' Remove niches, region, timeframes, and free offers.
Comment thoughtfully on 5 posts from Indian freelancers/agencies discussing client acquisition or video marketing — add value, don't pitch.
Reply to every story mention or comment on your own posts within 2 hours; move conversations to DM when they ask 'how?' or 'cost?'.
